C0926.title: Quanzhou Police Alert: Lottery Scams Among 10 Fraud Types Surging After Holidays
C0926.summary: In February 2023, the Quanzhou Anti-Fraud Center issued a post-holiday fraud prevention advisory, highlighting 10 common scam types including lottery scams. Fraudsters contact victims via SMS or phone calls claiming they have won a prize, then lure them to phishing websites or trick them into transferring money.

references.title: Someone in Quanzhou already scammed out of over 1 million yuan! Plus these other scams… Beware of 10 new and old types of fraud!
